name: 37208 · Nashville, TN
findings: ZIP 37208 (Nashville) has 107 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37208 (Nashville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 37208 (Nashville) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.
